title: Data Protection Policies and Session Management Controls
summary: Discovery Engine introduces Sensitive Data Protection (DLP) integration, configurable session management for Engines, and a breaking change making icon URLs read-only.
details:
This update introduces `GoogleCloudDiscoveryengineV1DataProtectionPolicy` across DataStores, DataConnectors, and AssistantCustomerPolicies, allowing developers to link Sensitive Data Protection (DLP) content policies for sanitizing uploads. A new `SessionConfig` has been added to the `Engine` resource, enabling control over session TTL (defaulting to 60 days) and management policies (e.g., `VERTEX_AI_MANAGED`). Additionally, the `widgetConfigs.get` method now supports an `END_USER_MOBILE` view for Gemini Enterprise mobile app integrations. 

**Breaking Change:** The `iconUrl` field within `WidgetConfig.UiSettings.ModelConfigInfo.ResolvedModel` is now marked as `readOnly`. Developers who previously attempted to write to this field during configuration updates must now treat it as an output-only absolute URL for brand marks.
